switches.name: --allow-unmeasured-memory
switches.purpose: Allow subagent context above the measured token limit.
switches.note: Keep it off unless the required context exceeds the measured memory limit.
switches.label: Allow larger context

switches.name: --api-key
switches.purpose: Require an API key from clients.
switches.note: Set a key when clients must authenticate; BUBO_API_KEY also works and keeps the key off the command line.
switches.label: API key

switches.name: --cache-disk
switches.purpose: Set the disk prompt cache directory.
switches.note: Opt in for fast restarts; model bytes are verified once, then a stamp skips later hashes.
switches.label: Disk cache

switches.name: --cache-disk-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit disk prompt cache storage.
switches.note: Keep 8 GiB unless the disk cache must retain more prompt snapshots.
switches.label: Disk cache limit

switches.name: --cache-disk-staging-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit RAM used to stage disk prompt snapshots.
switches.note: Keep automatic sizing unless disk persistence needs a different RAM limit.
switches.label: Disk cache staging memory

switches.name: --cache-ram-bytes
switches.purpose: Set the RAM snapshot cache budget.
switches.note: Keep the profile limit unless available host RAM requires a smaller cache.
switches.label: RAM cache size

switches.name: --context
switches.purpose: Set the context token limit for each session.
switches.note: Keep the profile context unless the task requires a different token limit.
switches.label: Context per session

switches.name: --debug-hooks
switches.purpose: Control debug hooks.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Debug hooks

switches.name: --dflash-model
switches.purpose: Control dflash model.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.
switches.label: Draft model

switches.name: --draft-head-model
switches.purpose: Select the prepared MTP draft head.
switches.note: Select the prepared MTP draft head.
switches.label: Draft head

switches.name: --draft-policy
switches.purpose: Control draft policy.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.
switches.label: Draft policy

switches.name: --draft-tokens
switches.purpose: Set the maximum speculative draft length.
switches.note: Keep seven tokens unless speculative draft length tests require another value.
switches.label: Longest draft

switches.name: --dspark-model
switches.purpose: Control dspark model.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.
switches.label: Speculative draft model

switches.name: --exact
switches.purpose: Select the exact profile.
switches.note: Enable it when output must repeat with the same build, prompt, and seed.
switches.label: Exact profile

switches.name: --frequency-penalty
switches.purpose: Penalize tokens by their generated occurrence count.
switches.note: Keep zero unless the task needs fewer frequently repeated tokens.
switches.label: Frequency Penalty (token frequency penalty)

switches.name: --help
switches.purpose: Control help.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Help

switches.name: --host
switches.purpose: Set the server listen address.
switches.note: Keep the local address unless remote clients must connect to the server.
switches.label: Listen address

switches.name: --log-level
switches.purpose: Set the amount of server log detail.
switches.note: Keep info unless diagnosis requires debug messages or normal operation needs fewer messages.
switches.label: Log detail

switches.name: --log-progress
switches.purpose: Log prompt processing progress.
switches.note: Keep it off unless prompt processing progress must appear in the log.
switches.label: Prompt progress log

switches.name: --loop-breaker
switches.purpose: Stop repeated answer and thinking loops.
switches.note: Keep on unless repeated text handling needs a comparison with it off.
switches.label: Loop breaker

switches.name: --manifest
switches.purpose: Control manifest.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Package manifest

switches.name: --max-buffered-output-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit buffered output for each request.
switches.note: Keep 64 KiB unless slow clients require more buffered output per request.
switches.label: Buffered output per request

switches.name: --max-buffered-output-total
switches.purpose: Limit buffered output across all requests.
switches.note: Keep 256 KiB unless concurrent slow clients require more total buffered output.
switches.label: Total buffered output

switches.name: --max-connections
switches.purpose: Limit simultaneous HTTP connections.
switches.note: Keep 16 unless the client workload requires more simultaneous HTTP connections.
switches.label: Connection limit

switches.name: --max-output-bytes
switches.purpose: Limit output text bytes for each request.
switches.note: Keep 1 MiB unless a request must return more output text.
switches.label: Output byte limit

switches.name: --max-pending
switches.purpose: Limit queued requests.
switches.note: Keep 16 unless the workload requires a larger request queue.
switches.label: Queue limit

switches.name: --max-pending-per-client
switches.purpose: Limit queued requests from each client.
switches.note: Keep the queue limit unless one client must have a smaller request allowance.
switches.label: Queue limit per client

switches.name: --max-request-bytes
switches.purpose: Set the maximum HTTP request body size.
switches.note: Keep 64 MiB unless larger request bodies are required.
switches.label: Request byte limit

switches.name: --max-score-tokens
switches.purpose: Control max score tokens.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Score token limit

switches.name: --max-tokens
switches.purpose: Limit new tokens generated per request.
switches.note: Keep unlimited generation unless responses need a fixed new token limit.
switches.label: Max Tokens (new tokens per request)

switches.name: --min-draft-tokens
switches.purpose: Set the minimum speculative draft length.
switches.note: Keep one token unless speculative draft tests require a larger minimum.
switches.label: Shortest draft

switches.name: --min-keep
switches.purpose: Retain a minimum number of sampling candidates.
switches.note: Keep zero unless probability filters must retain a minimum number of candidates.
switches.label: Min Keep (minimum sampling candidates)

switches.name: --min-p
switches.purpose: Filter tokens by probability relative to the best token.
switches.note: Keep zero unless the task needs minimum probability filtering.
switches.label: Min P (relative probability filter)

switches.name: --mmproj
switches.purpose: Set the vision file.
switches.note: Set the matching vision file when the model must process images.
switches.label: Vision file

switches.name: --model
switches.purpose: Control model.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Model

switches.name: --mtp-draft-vocab
switches.purpose: Select the MTP draft head vocabulary.
switches.note: Keep the profile vocabulary unless draft vocabulary tests require another setting.
switches.label: Draft vocabulary

switches.name: --mtp-model
switches.purpose: Set the MTP file.
switches.note: Set the matching MTP file when speculative decoding is required.
switches.label: MTP drafts and draft head

switches.name: --mtp-policy
switches.purpose: Select the MTP draft length controller.
switches.note: Keep survival unless draft acceptance tests require the length policy.
switches.label: Draft length control

switches.name: --no-behaviour
switches.purpose: Disable the eight behaviour defaults.
switches.note: Keep policies enabled unless plain sampling is required outside the exact profile.
switches.label: Disable behaviour defaults

switches.name: --no-cache
switches.purpose: Disable RAM and disk prompt caches for all requests.
switches.note: Enable it when every request must prefill its full prompt for reproducible output.
switches.label: Disable prompt caches

switches.name: --no-cache-disk
switches.purpose: Disable the disk snapshot cache.
switches.note: Enable it when the supplied disk cache directory must be ignored.
switches.label: Disable disk cache

switches.name: --no-draft-head
switches.purpose: Suppress the manifest draft output head.
switches.note: Enable it when MTP must run without the supplied draft head.
switches.label: Disable draft head

switches.name: --no-mtp
switches.purpose: Disable MTP defaults and the speculative backend.
switches.note: Enable it when decoding must run without MTP.
switches.label: Disable MTP drafts

switches.name: --no-prompt-lookup
switches.purpose: Disable prompt lookup proposals.
switches.note: Keep prompt lookup enabled with MTP unless lookup comparisons require it off.
switches.label: Disable prompt lookup

switches.name: --no-twin
switches.purpose: Suppress the manifest dense twin.
switches.note: Turn the prepared dense twin off to release its model storage.
switches.label: Disable decode twin

switches.name: --no-vision
switches.purpose: Turn off the vision file that the package names.
switches.note: Use it when the server must run without the vision file.
switches.label: Disable image input

switches.name: --npu-prefill
switches.purpose: Use NPU prefill when available.
switches.note: Off by default; set on to use the NPU for long prompt prefill, with GPU fallback if startup fails.
switches.label: NPU prefill

switches.name: --port
switches.purpose: Set the server listen port.
switches.note: Keep 8080 unless another service uses that port or clients require a different port.
switches.label: Port

switches.name: --prefill-chunk
switches.purpose: Limit prompt tokens between active decode rounds.
switches.note: Keep 512 unless active sessions need shorter pauses during another request prefill.
switches.label: Prompt tokens between generation rounds

switches.name: --presence-penalty
switches.purpose: Penalize tokens already generated in the response.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different penalty for previously generated tokens.
switches.label: Presence Penalty (repeated token penalty)

switches.name: --preserve-thinking
switches.purpose: Select which thinking history to retain.
switches.note: Keep auto unless the client requires a different policy for retained thinking history.
switches.label: Thinking history

switches.name: --print-effective-settings
switches.purpose: Print resolved settings as JSON and exit.
switches.note: Enable it when resolved settings must be inspected without loading a model.
switches.label: Print settings

switches.name: --profile
switches.purpose: Select the release settings profile.
switches.note: Use vanilla without Bubo tuning; stock remains an alias for this renamed profile.
switches.label: Profile

switches.name: --prompt-lookup
switches.purpose: Propose tokens from an earlier conversation match.
switches.note: Keep it enabled with MTP unless prompt lookup comparisons require it off.
switches.label: Prompt lookup

switches.name: --reasoning-effort
switches.purpose: Set the default reasoning effort.
switches.note: Keep medium unless the task requires a different reasoning effort.
switches.label: Reasoning effort

switches.name: --repeat-last-n
switches.purpose: Set the recent token window for repetition penalties.
switches.note: Keep 64 unless repetition penalties need a different recent token window.
switches.label: Repeat Last N (repetition window)

switches.name: --repeat-penalty
switches.purpose: Penalize recently used tokens.
switches.note: Keep one unless the task needs a penalty for recent repeated tokens.
switches.label: Repeat Penalty (repetition penalty)

switches.name: --request-timeout-ms
switches.purpose: Limit request time in milliseconds.
switches.note: Keep zero unless requests must stop after a fixed time limit.
switches.label: Request timeout

switches.name: --root
switches.purpose: Control root.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Root folder

switches.name: --seed
switches.purpose: Set the random sampling seed.
switches.note: Use a nonnegative seed for reproducibility; exact uses one unless another nonnegative seed is supplied.
switches.label: Seed (random seed)

switches.name: --served-model-name
switches.purpose: Set the model identifier exposed by the API.
switches.default_text: Package ID or GGUF file name
switches.note: Override the package ID or GGUF file name shown to clients; bubo remains an accepted alias.
switches.label: API model name

switches.name: --sessions
switches.purpose: Set the number of preallocated request sessions.
switches.note: Keep one for exact output or select subagents when four requests must run concurrently.
switches.label: Sessions

switches.name: --speculative
switches.purpose: Select the speculative draft backend.
switches.default_text: mtp with an MTP file (Flash Next and Gemma 4); otherwise off
switches.note: Speeds up replies for a single request; with two or more sessions the gain is small.
switches.label: Draft method

switches.name: --stall-timeout-ms
switches.purpose: Exit as device lost when generation makes no progress for this many milliseconds.
switches.note: Keep zero unless a supervisor restarts the server; the minimum is 60000.
switches.label: Stall timeout

switches.name: --temperature
switches.purpose: Set the randomness of token sampling.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs different randomness or greedy decoding with zero.
switches.label: Temperature

switches.name: --think
switches.purpose: Set the default reasoning mode.
switches.note: Keep on unless the task does not need reasoning.
switches.label: Thinking mode

switches.name: --think-marker-bias
switches.purpose: Set a fixed thinking marker probability bias.
switches.note: Keep zero unless the task needs a fixed thinking marker bias.
switches.label: Reasoning length

switches.name: --top-k
switches.purpose: Limit sampling to the highest probability candidates.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different sampling candidate limit.
switches.label: Top K (sampling candidate limit)

switches.name: --top-p
switches.purpose: Filter sampling candidates by cumulative probability.
switches.note: Keep the model preset unless the task needs a different cumulative probability limit.
switches.label: Top P (cumulative probability filter)

switches.name: --trace
switches.purpose: Write request and generation content to a JSONL file.
switches.note: The trace file contains client content.
switches.label: Request trace

switches.name: --ttl
switches.purpose: Control ttl.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Time to live

switches.name: --twin-model
switches.purpose: Select the prepared dense twin.
switches.note: Use the prepared twin; speed was measured with the draft head.
switches.label: 4-bit decode twin

switches.name: --verbose
switches.purpose: Control verbose.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Verbose logging

switches.name: --verify-model
switches.purpose: Hash all eight manifest files plus distinct overrides before loading (about 2-4 minutes on SSD).
switches.note: Use full verification to detect payload corruption before loading.
switches.label: Check every model file before loading

switches.name: --voice
switches.purpose: Control voice.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Voice

switches.name: --voice-lang
switches.purpose: Control voice lang.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Voice language

switches.name: --voice-text
switches.purpose: Control voice text.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Voice text

switches.name: A3B_ATTN_CHECK
switches.purpose: Control the a3b attn check setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Attention check

switches.name: A3B_ATTN_PRECISE
switches.purpose: Control the a3b attn precise setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Precise attention

switches.name: A3B_DECODE_ATTN
switches.purpose: Control the a3b decode attn setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Decode attention

switches.name: A3B_DFLASH_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control the a3b dflash profile setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Draft profiling

switches.name: A3B_NO_RESUME
switches.purpose: Control the a3b no resume setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Disable resume

switches.name: A3B_PROBE_ONLY
switches.purpose: Control the a3b probe only setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Probe only

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_ATTN_CHECK
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide attn check setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Wide attention check

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_BF16_BLAS
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide bf16 blas setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Wide brain float multiplication

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_BLAS_F32
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide blas f32 setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Wide float multiplication

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_DEBUG
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide debug setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Wide kernel debugging

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_F16_MAXCOLS
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide f16 maxcols setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Half precision column limit

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_F16_MINROWS
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide f16 minrows setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Half precision row minimum

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_FN_ATTN
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide fn attn setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Wide attention function

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_NO_DOWN64
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide no down64 setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Disable narrow projection

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_NO_F16
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide no f16 setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Disable half precision

switches.name: A3B_WIDE_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control the a3b wide profile setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Wide kernel profiling

switches.name: BUBO_API_KEY
switches.purpose: Provide the server API key; --api-key takes precedence.
switches.note: Read when --api-key is absent. The value is never printed or listed.
switches.label: Server API key

switches.name: BUBO_MANIFEST
switches.purpose: Select bubo-package.json; explicit --manifest takes precedence.
switches.note: Set a package manifest when automatic discovery cannot find it.
switches.label: Package manifest

switches.name: BUBO_MMPROJ
switches.purpose: Select the vision projector; explicit --mmproj takes precedence.
switches.note: Select the vision projector; explicit --mmproj takes precedence.
switches.label: Vision projector

switches.name: BUBO_MTP_MODEL
switches.purpose: Select the MTP file; explicit --mtp-model takes precedence.
switches.note: Select the MTP file; explicit --mtp-model takes precedence.
switches.label: MTP file

switches.name: BUBO_RUNTIME_DIR
switches.purpose: Set the prepared runtime folder.
switches.note: Set when the prepared runtime is stored in another folder.
switches.label: Runtime folder

switches.name: DS4_LOCK_FILE
switches.purpose: Control the ds4 lock file setting.
switches.note: Other model or test configuration; no release default.
switches.label: Lock file

switches.name: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES
switches.purpose: Set the hardware queue cap.
switches.note: The engine manages this queue cap; a real environment value wins.
switches.label: Hardware queue cap

switches.name: GUFO_A3B_DATA
switches.purpose: Control a3b data.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Model data

switches.name: GUFO_A3B_MODEL
switches.purpose: Control a3b model.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Model file

switches.name: GUFO_BATCH_DRAFT_HEAD
switches.purpose: Control batch draft head.
switches.note: unclassified
switches.label: Batch draft head

switches.name: GUFO_CACHE_HOST_FLOOR_MB
switches.purpose: Reserve available host RAM during snapshot admission.
switches.note: Snapshot admission keeps this many MiB of host RAM available, and 0 turns the floor off.
switches.label: Host RAM floor

switches.name: GUFO_CACHE_REMOVAL_LOG
switches.purpose: Control cache removal log.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Cache removal log

switches.name: GUFO_DEBUG_HOOKS
switches.purpose: Control debug hooks.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Debug hooks

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_DSPARK_TIMING
switches.purpose: Control deepseek dspark timing.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_DSPARK_TRACE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek dspark trace.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Draft trace

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_DSPARK_WIDTH_TRACE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek dspark width trace.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Draft width trace

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_ROCM_DECODE_STAGE_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek rocm decode stage profile.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Decode stage profiling

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_ROCM_GRAPH_PREFILL_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek rocm graph prefill profile.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Prefill graph profiling

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_ROCM_GRAPH_TOKEN_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek rocm graph token profile.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Token graph profiling

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_ROCM_INDEXER_STAGE_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek rocm indexer stage profile.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Indexer stage profiling

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_ROCM_LAYER_STAGE_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek rocm layer stage profile.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Layer stage profiling

switches.name: GUFO_DEEPSEEK_ROCM_Q_STAGE_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control deepseek rocm q stage profile.
switches.note: Use this diagnostic with DeepSeek V4 Flash.
switches.label: Query stage profiling

switches.name: GUFO_DENSE_TWIN_ALLOW_Q8
switches.purpose: Control dense twin allow q8.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Allow eight bit twin

switches.name: GUFO_DENSE_TWIN_BATCH
switches.purpose: Enable dense twin decode with multiple sessions.
switches.note: Keep the profile setting unless batched twin comparisons require a different setting.
switches.label: Twin batch decode

switches.name: GUFO_DENSE_TWIN_MAX_N
switches.purpose: Limit the dense twin batch width.
switches.note: Keep eight unless batched twin tests outside exact require a different batch limit.
switches.label: Twin batch width

switches.name: GUFO_DENSE_TWIN_MODEL
switches.purpose: Select the four bit dense weights used for decode and verify.
switches.note: Set the matching dense twin when faster decoding outside exact is required.
switches.label: Dense twin weights

switches.name: GUFO_DENSE_TWIN_SHADOW
switches.purpose: Control dense twin shadow.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Twin shadow

switches.name: GUFO_DENSE_TWIN_TRACE
switches.purpose: Control dense twin trace.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Twin trace

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_BOUNDARY_ALIGN
switches.purpose: Control disk boundary align.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Disk boundary alignment

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_DEFER
switches.purpose: Defer disk writes until idle.
switches.note: Keep the disk bundle setting unless disk write deferral tests require another setting.
switches.label: Defer disk writes

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_DEFER_MS
switches.purpose: Control disk defer ms.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Disk write delay

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_EVICT_BACKLOG_BYTES
switches.purpose: Control disk evict backlog bytes.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Disk eviction backlog

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_EVICT_DOMINATED
switches.purpose: Skip snapshots covered by a longer retained snapshot.
switches.note: Keep the disk bundle setting unless dominated snapshot eviction tests require another setting.
switches.label: Skip covered snapshots

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_EVICT_SKIP_TOKENS
switches.purpose: Skip snapshot writes close to an existing persisted prefix.
switches.note: Keep 8192 with disk caching unless eviction tests require a different minimum prompt length.
switches.label: Snapshot write spacing

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_IDLE_MS
switches.purpose: Control disk idle ms.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Disk idle interval

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_INPASS
switches.purpose: Enable disk snapshots during prefill passes.
switches.note: Keep one unless disk cache tests require in-pass checkpoints to be disabled.
switches.label: Prefill disk snapshots

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_PERSIST
switches.purpose: Persist disk snapshots on eviction after idle.
switches.note: Keep the disk bundle policy unless persistence tests require a different write policy.
switches.label: Persist idle snapshots

switches.name: GUFO_DISK_SLICE
switches.purpose: Control disk slice.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Disk slice

switches.name: GUFO_DISPATCH_TELEMETRY
switches.purpose: Control dispatch telemetry.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Dispatch telemetry

switches.name: GUFO_INCREMENTAL_TOKENIZE
switches.purpose: Reuse verified text render and token prefixes for exact conversation appends. Inspect incremental_tokenize counters in render timeline events.
switches.note: Doubtful requests take a counted full path; set 0 and restart to turn it off.
switches.label: Incremental conversation tokenization

switches.name: GUFO_ROUTED_WMMA_IQ
switches.purpose: Enable the F16 WMMA route for supported IQ and Q2 expert weights.
switches.note: Set 0 to compare the MMQ fallback; non-IQ expert models keep their existing routes.
switches.label: IQ expert WMMA route

switches.name: GUFO_IQ_ROUTE_MIN_ROWS
switches.purpose: Set the minimum forward-pass rows for the IQ expert WMMA route.
switches.note: Keep 256 unless comparing IQ expert dispatch at another forward-pass row threshold.
switches.label: Minimum IQ route rows

switches.name: GUFO_DRAFT_OUT_MODEL
switches.purpose: Select the four bit output head used for MTP drafts.
switches.note: Set the matching draft head when faster MTP decoding outside exact is required.
switches.label: Output head used for drafts

switches.name: GUFO_DRAFT_VOCAB_AUTO
switches.purpose: Set thresholds for automatic draft vocabulary selection.
switches.default_text: 2,16,64 (2 of last 16 non-latin; back after 64 latin)
switches.note: Keep the default thresholds unless automatic draft vocabulary tests require different thresholds.
switches.label: Draft vocabulary thresholds

switches.name: GUFO_EOG_BOUNDARY
switches.purpose: Permit EOG tokens at allowed boundaries.
switches.note: Keep it enabled unless end token boundary comparisons require it off.
switches.label: Stop token boundaries

switches.name: GUFO_EOG_DEFER_P
switches.purpose: Set the deferred stop probability.
switches.note: Keep the default unless early end token deferral tests require a different probability.
switches.label: Deferred stop probability

switches.name: GUFO_EOG_MIN_PROB
switches.purpose: Set the minimum EOG probability required to stop.
switches.note: Keep the default unless end token probability tests require another minimum.
switches.label: Minimum stop probability

switches.name: GUFO_EOG_MIN_PROB_EXACT
switches.purpose: Compute EOG probability over the full vocabulary.
switches.note: Keep it off unless end token decisions require full vocabulary probabilities.
switches.label: Full vocabulary stop probability

switches.purpose: Control eval api key.

switches.purpose: Control eval artifact id.

switches.name: GUFO_EXPERT_OVERLAY_MODEL
switches.purpose: Replace the routed experts of the model with those of another GGUF of the same architecture.
switches.note: Experimental hybrid-model setting that stays unset in normal use.

switches.name: GUFO_EXPERT_OVERLAY_KEEP
switches.purpose: Name the routed-expert tensors that keep the base model's weights when an overlay is set.
switches.note: Read only when the overlay model is set.

switches.name: GUFO_EXPERT_V2K
switches.purpose: Grouped expert kernel (decode).
switches.note: Keep this experimental kernel off except for decode kernel comparisons.

switches.purpose: Control ffmpeg.

switches.purpose: Control ffprobe.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.

switches.purpose: Control grouped down.

switches.purpose: Control hipblaslt plan cache.

switches.name: GUFO_HOST
switches.purpose: Set the server address through the environment.
switches.note: Leave it unset unless the server address must come from this environment variable.
switches.label: Server address

switches.name: GUFO_IQ4_WIDE_VARIANT
switches.purpose: Control iq4 wide variant.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Wide quantized kernel

switches.name: GUFO_IQ4_WMMA_WAVES
switches.purpose: Control iq4 wmma waves.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Matrix wave count

switches.name: GUFO_LENIENT
switches.purpose: Accept near miss MTP drafts inside thinking spans.
switches.note: Keep bounded outside exact unless strict speculative acceptance is required.
switches.label: Accept near-miss drafts inside thinking

switches.name: GUFO_LENIENT_LAMBDA
switches.purpose: Set the lenient speculative acceptance bound.
switches.note: Keep the default unless lenient acceptance tests require a different bound.
switches.label: Near-miss acceptance limit

switches.name: GUFO_LENIENT_THINK_ONLY
switches.purpose: Limit lenient acceptance to thinking output.
switches.note: Keep the thinking gate unless lenient acceptance tests must include non-thinking output.
switches.label: Thinking only lenience

switches.name: GUFO_LOGIT_BIAS
switches.purpose: Enable request token probability adjustments.
switches.note: Keep it off unless requests must change token probabilities with logit bias.
switches.label: Token probability adjustments

switches.name: GUFO_LOG_SYNC
switches.purpose: Write logs synchronously for crash diagnostics.
switches.note: Use 1 for synchronous logs. A hard crash can lose about 100 ms of asynchronous logs.
switches.label: Synchronous logs

switches.name: GUFO_LOOP_BREAKER
switches.purpose: Stop repeated answer and thinking loops.
switches.note: Keep it enabled unless repeated text handling comparisons require it off.
switches.label: Loop breaker

switches.name: GUFO_LOOP_BREAKER_EOG_CLOSE
switches.purpose: Close a detected loop with an EOG token.
switches.note: Keep it enabled unless loop termination tests must omit response closure.
switches.label: Loop stop token

switches.name: GUFO_LOOP_BREAKER_TOOL_ARGS
switches.purpose: Stop framing loops inside tool-call arguments.
switches.note: Set to 0 for tool-argument loop comparisons when GUFO_LOOP_BREAKER is enabled.
switches.label: Tool argument loop breaker

switches.name: GUFO_LOOP_BREAKER_TRANSITION
switches.purpose: Select the loop breaker transition mode.
switches.note: Keep two unless loop transition tests require another transition mode.
switches.label: Loop transition

switches.name: GUFO_LOOP_BREAKER_TRANSITION_TEXT
switches.purpose: Set the text used for loop breaker transitions.
switches.note: Keep the built-in text unless loop termination requires a different transition message.
switches.label: Loop transition text

switches.name: GUFO_MAX_IMAGE_TOKENS
switches.purpose: Limit image tokens admitted for a request.
switches.default_text: 65536 on Flash Next, no cap on Gemma 4
switches.note: Unset, Flash Next allows 65536 image tokens per request, counting every image in the prompt.
switches.label: Image-token limit

switches.name: GUFO_MEM_ACCOUNTING
switches.purpose: Control mem accounting.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Memory accounting

switches.name: GUFO_MODEL_SUPPRESS_TOKENS
switches.purpose: Enable model token suppression.
switches.note: Keep it off unless model token suppression is required.
switches.label: Token suppression

switches.name: GUFO_MASK_THREADS
switches.purpose: Set worker threads for tool grammar mask cache misses.
switches.note: Default eight shared worker threads (one process-wide pool); zero uses the serial walk; values are capped by eight and hardware threads.
switches.label: Grammar mask threads

switches.name: GUFO_MOE_BENCH
switches.purpose: Control moe bench.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Expert benchmark

switches.name: GUFO_MTP_TRACE
switches.purpose: Write one trace line for each decode cycle.
switches.note: Trace output uses bounded asynchronous logging. Synchronous trace output can reduce decode speed.
switches.label: Decode cycle trace

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_CHIP_POWER
switches.purpose: Log chip power during NPU prefill with literal zero or one.
switches.note: Logging only: it reads RAPL package power and never limits the NPU.
switches.label: NPU chip power logging

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_DIR
switches.purpose: Locate NPU artifacts for enabled prefill.
switches.note: Overrides the artifact directory beside the packaged bin folder; cannot enable NPU mode.
switches.label: NPU artifact folder

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_GATE_SLICES
switches.purpose: Select zero through twelve paired query and gate slices.
switches.note: Consumed only when NPU prefill is enabled.
switches.label: NPU query and gate slices

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_GUARD
switches.purpose: Hold NPU prefill during high power or memory pressure with on, off or log.
switches.note: Envelope guard without proven benefit: a hold never fails a request; log mode only records.
switches.label: NPU power and memory guard

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_GUARD_TEST
switches.purpose: Set the guard power threshold and hold time for tests as power_w and hold_s.
switches.note: Internal test setting, honoured only with debug hooks; not for normal use.
switches.label: NPU guard test override

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_HAL_MONITOR
switches.purpose: Log Windows NPU IOMMU fault events with literal zero or one.
switches.note: Detection only: it logs NPU fault events and never turns the NPU off.
switches.label: NPU fault event monitoring

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_KEEPALIVE
switches.purpose: Enable periodic heartbeat with literal zero or one.
switches.note: Consumed only when NPU prefill is enabled.
switches.label: NPU heartbeat

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_KEEPALIVE_MS
switches.purpose: Set heartbeat interval to zero or one hundred through sixty thousand milliseconds.
switches.note: Consumed only when NPU prefill is enabled.
switches.label: NPU heartbeat interval

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_MEM_TRACE
switches.purpose: Log NPU buffer page residency and GPU memory with literal zero or one.
switches.note: Logging only: it samples memory counters and never changes NPU work.
switches.label: NPU memory trace logging

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_SHEXP
switches.purpose: Enable shared expert staging with literal zero or one.
switches.note: Consumed only when NPU prefill is enabled.
switches.label: Shared expert staging

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_SLICES
switches.purpose: Select one through twelve linear z slices for enabled prefill.
switches.note: Consumed only when NPU prefill is enabled.
switches.label: NPU linear slices

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_TEST_FAIL_CHUNK
switches.purpose: Report one NPU prefill chunk of each request as invalid, to test the GPU retry.
switches.note: Internal test setting, honoured only with debug hooks; not for normal use.
switches.label: NPU chunk failure test

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_TIMEOUT_MS
switches.purpose: Bound NPU completion to one through eight thousand milliseconds.
switches.note: Consumed only when NPU prefill is enabled.
switches.label: NPU completion timeout

switches.name: GUFO_NPU_WEIGHT_GUARD
switches.purpose: Re-send a changed NPU weight buffer with literal zero or one.
switches.note: Debug check read from the process environment only; it compares the first and last 4 KiB of reused weights.
switches.label: NPU weight integrity checks

switches.name: GUFO_PLATFORM_TUNING
switches.purpose: Control Windows timing and memory placement switches.
switches.note: GUFO_PLATFORM_TUNING=none is a diagnostic that slows Windows decode.
switches.label: Platform tuning

switches.name: GUFO_PORT
switches.purpose: Set the server port through the environment.
switches.note: Leave it unset unless the server port must come from this environment variable.
switches.label: Server port

switches.name: GUFO_PREFILL_DIAG
switches.purpose: Control prefill diag.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Prefill diagnostics

switches.name: GUFO_PREFILL_FORWARD_TOKENS
switches.purpose: Set the maximum tokens in each prefill forward pass.
switches.note: Keep 4096 unless prefill geometry tests outside exact require a different pass size.
switches.label: Most tokens in one prompt pass

switches.name: GUFO_PREFILL_STEP_LOG
switches.purpose: Control prefill step log.
switches.note: This tree has no reader for this variable.
switches.label: Prefill step log

switches.name: GUFO_PREFILL_TARGET_MS
switches.purpose: Control prefill target ms.
switches.note: This tree has no reader for this variable.

switches.name: GUFO_PRODUCTION_SAMPLING

switches.name: GUFO_QWEN27_PROFILE
switches.purpose: Control qwen27 profile.
switches.note: Use this switch with its model family.
switches.label: Model profiling

switches.name: GUFO_REASONING_BUDGET
switches.purpose: Enable request reasoning token budgets.

switches.name: GUFO_REQUIRE_GPU
switches.purpose: Control require hip.

switches.label: Require GPU

switches.name: GUFO_REQUIRE_HIP
switches.purpose: Control require hip.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Require GPU runtime

switches.name: GUFO_ROUTED_LANEROW
switches.purpose: Enable the routed expert prefill kernel.
switches.note: Keep the profile setting unless routed expert kernel comparisons require a different setting outside exact.
switches.label: Lane-row prefill

switches.name: GUFO_SPEC_EOG_STOP
switches.purpose: Permit speculative EOG stops.
switches.note: Keep it enabled unless speculative end token comparisons require it off.
switches.label: Speculative stop tokens

switches.name: GUFO_SURVIVAL_FLOOR
switches.purpose: Control survival floor.
switches.note: Inventory classification.
switches.label: Draft survival floor

switches.name: GUFO_THINK_EOG_GUARD
switches.purpose: Block end of turn inside an unfinished thinking span.
switches.note: Keep it enabled unless thinking termination comparisons require it off.
switches.label: Thinking stop guard

switches.name: GUFO_THINK_GUARD_ESCALATE
switches.purpose: Close an unfinished thinking span after this many blocked end-of-turn tries. 0 turns it off.
switches.note: Keep 16 unless thinking guard tests require a different end token streak length.
switches.label: Thinking guard limit

switches.name: GUFO_THINK_MARKER_BIAS
switches.purpose: Set a fixed thinking marker probability bias.
switches.note: Keep zero unless a fixed thinking marker bias is required outside exact.
switches.label: Thinking marker bias

switches.name: GUFO_THINK_MARKER_BIAS_BY_EFFORT
switches.purpose: Map reasoning effort to think marker bias.
switches.note: Keep the default map unless reasoning effort tests require different thinking marker biases.
switches.label: Thinking bias by effort

switches.name: GUFO_THINK_MARKER_ENTROPY_GATE
switches.purpose: Gate thinking marker bias at a raw top-k entropy threshold in nats.
switches.note: Set the threshold from local thinking entropy measurements for marker bias comparisons.
switches.label: Thinking entropy gate

switches.name: GUFO_THINK_MARKER_LIST
switches.purpose: Control think marker list.
